title.en: The Human Solutions Museum (人类解决问题的方法博物馆)

summary.en: A research question (which systems resisted a runaway dynamic, and what do they share?) and a product specification: inventions re-archived as dossiers from problem to borrowable method, indexed by problem structure. The only live mention lists it as a design programme, correspondence not established. Its regulation question and separations have forms in the account, mostly in part, in models and readings. Its collection, index and 奏折 reading do not. Divergence kept: forward, 'solved', 'good tool', a human list against every continuation, tradition's efficacy, human write-back of AI links.

name.en: Civilization as an accumulated stock of methods

source.locator: The theory in one paragraph; Claims 19, 26-28, 83

sense.en: Civilization is not a sequence of clever objects but an accumulated stock of methods by which people turned real problems into working mechanisms, tangible and intangible on equal terms (law, money, schools, human rights). Ordinary readers should learn that civilization did not happen naturally: it is generation after generation solving problems.

entries.quote: 文明不是自然发生的，而是一代代人解决问题的结果

reading.en: Passing has forms: a pattern outlasting brief carriers lasts through passing, under a supplied premise; a rule's change enters at a gated step; an AI reading sets law-like institutions among laws of viability. None says a civilization is a stock, or that problem-solving made it. 'Not natural' draws a split the account would have to give a relational basis for, and does not make. The only live mention: a design programme. [AI reading]

says.en: World, any web: “A pattern outlasting its carriers lasts through passing.” Under the passing premise, supplied, “every beginning is a passing”; without it, a double-negation form that names no carrier.
Any process: a quantity is kept along every ungated course exactly when every ungated step keeps it; a course that changes it splits at a gated step that changes it, values decided.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: constraints of social viability, such as cooperation among strangers and forming the next members, are read as laws under stated hypotheses; “the correspondence is the reading's, the laws are the homes'.”

Root, a family of models: an entry rule on a shared stock passed through members who also keep it. That any actual institution meets the hypotheses, “or that this is what an institution is”, is not shown (record).
“(design programmes, not results; correspondence not established)”: names the human solutions museum among others.

account_adds.en: No law says cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping. Where a rule is kept, it can be kept and be the wrong rule [AI reading].

source_adds.en: Civilization as the unit; methods as what accumulates; that what exists results from problem-solving; tangible and intangible creations on equal terms.

name.en: A civilizational advance has a canonical seven-stage shape

source.locator: The argument: The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: A civilizational advance has a canonical shape with separable stages: a real problem, a misreading of it, an insight redefining it, a mechanism on a named substrate, diffusion by a named force, what it solved, the new problems it made. Each stage does work no other does. The README calls this the claim that makes the museum a theory and not a format.

entries.quote: a civilizational advance has a canonical shape with seven stages

reading.en: The account has no sequence of stages for change or for an advance: its laws read courses under hypotheses, and the root lists 'inevitable improvement or universal growth' among what is not assumed. Single stages have neighbours (see the reframing, diffusion and new-problems entries); the shape does not. 'Stages' in the live text are stages of inquiry (诘); 'misread' there names a misread case in T5, not a frame held of a problem. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The seven-stage shape itself, and that each stage can be interrogated separately across cases.

searched: dossier, canonical shape, stages of, civilizational, progress, inevitable improvement, framed, moraliz, privatiz, naturaliz across the overview, chapters, reviews and glossary

name.en: Real problems, solved by mechanisms

source.locator: Claims 28, 75; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: Problems are real and exist in a setting. A mechanism solves something, changing behaviours, relations, institutions, risks or capabilities. Inventions are not novelties from nowhere but mechanisms humans developed when facing real problems. The axis is problem to method.

entries.quote: 发明不是凭空出现的新奇物，而是人类面对真实问题时发展出的机制

reading.en: The account begins from relations with no solver presupposed. 'Solved' has the form of a standard met, read against something supplied, and meeting it says nothing of significance. So 'real problem' would have to say what reads it, for whom, among what it can tell apart. The source states no such split. Its claim concerns humans and is not refuted by the account, which lists its requirements as supplied. [AI reading]

says.en: “Activity includes change and interaction without presupposing an agent, an intention or a purpose.”

Standard: “what something is read against, so that it can be met or missed: a requirement on a level, an acceptable set of acts, a task.” “That a standard is met says nothing of whether meeting it has significance.”
In the table of what is shown and supplied, under Supplied: “the reading and the requirement a response answers to, the task, the set level”.

account_adds.en: What a response takes in is mapped, and the requirement it answers to enters as a hypothesis, not as something found in the situation.

source_adds.en: A claim about what humans in fact faced and did, which the account does not catalogue.

name.en: Moving civilization forward as the selection question

source.locator: Claims 18, 29-31; Relations (zhishan)

sense.en: An exhibit is selected not for novelty, being first or fame, but for moving humanistic civilization one step forward. Five criteria include expanding expression, choice, dignity, freedom, safety, cooperation or understanding. Ambivalent inventions may enter if both what they solved and what they made are shown. The README calls this a usable test of whether a technology is good.

entries.quote: 是否扩大了人的表达、选择、尊严、自由、安全、协作或理解能力

reading.en: Near C in form only, and apart in three ways. The source says forward with no premise; here widening is better only under C for order, with the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted, warrant open. The source lists human capabilities; C reads what can form, and the condition's scope is for anything, so a human-centred gain can be mixed. An ambivalent invention is a mixed comparison, which C does not decide. Both refuse novelty as what is read. [AI reading]

says.en: “The ethics adds two premises, neither asserted, warrant open”. The continuation condition “fixes scope, whose losses count: from every standpoint, for anything, its continuation into the future has significance.” “*C*: widening what can form is better.”

Any type, finite listing, two-valued admission: one course widens another exactly when every weighting positive on the listed items weighs it higher; “a mixed comparison, a gain here and a loss there, is decided both ways by positive weightings”.

Generation is a pattern going on through carrying renewal, and 生生 life in the whole, “not novelty or scale”; an expansion that ends forms of life another course keeps is mixed with it and C does not rank them.

account_adds.en: Widening says which admits more, not which is better; it decides no mixed comparison, and weights that do are a further premise.

source_adds.en: A named list of human goods and durable influence as admission criteria. The account names no such list and offers no test of whether a technology is good.

name.en: Every dossier shows the new problems: no sanctifying, no terminal mechanism

source.locator: Claims 30, 38; Four refusals: Anti-sanctification; Relations (meta-attractor)

sense.en: Any advance may have side effects: misuse, controversy, new inequalities. The new-problems module is mandatory, because a borrower must know the cost. The museum must not sanctify inventions but show their complexity. The README adds that every solution makes a new problem landscape, so no mechanism is terminal.

entries.quote: 本馆不应把发明神圣化，而要展示它们的复杂性

reading.en: Three parts. The refusal has the account's form: no law evaluates, and no type of closure is good or bad by its type. Cost has checked forms only under clauses: a rise paid from beyond where a containing family gains nothing; a new dependence where a giver drew on what it did not depend on. 'No terminal mechanism' has a law's form, for a fixed rule's possible, not for problems. Nothing ranks here without C. [AI reading]

says.en: World, balance, the risen family within a containing family gaining nothing: “the rise is paid from beyond in full”. The record does not show “That drawing from beyond is wrong.”

World, the reading of drawing at the descent a hypothesis: a dependence forms anew exactly where the giver drew on what it did not depend on. “The law says where a new dependence comes from, not why.”

Any process: where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening. Reading [AI reading, D45]: “Openness is then a property of how rules keep changing, not of any rule chosen once.”
“No law evaluates: none says a loss is a harm or restraint better.”
「一种闭是否支持、丰富或损害生生，由比较来说，不由类型来说」: scope by the continuation condition, order by C, both unasserted [AI reading, D49].

account_adds.en: Past the slack, a dependence breaks unseen by every selection rewarding the rise (05 §6). No loss is called a harm.

source_adds.en: The historical cost of actual inventions, and misuse and controversy as kinds of cost. The folder also reads this module as the meta-attractor's insight; the glossary's meta-attractor means closed capture and “never” the wider working sense.

name.en: The reframing thesis: insight over technology

source.locator: Claims 33-34, 44; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: What pushes civilization forward is usually not the technology but a new insight, of the kind that redefines the problem rather than answering the old version. Dossiers must show how a problem was misunderstood, moralized, suppressed or ignored, and why the old frame bounded the available solutions.

entries.quote: 真正推动文明前进的，往往不是技术本身，而是一个新的洞察

reading.en: Redefining a problem changes what would count as meeting it. The nearest law revises a reading with acceptability held fixed, and its reading says the relation to double-loop learning depends on changing a governing norm. So the source's own kind of insight is not what is modelled. A revision opens a correction with the gain from reading, executability or both; a coined form returns a merged distinction; a reading formed from the share is absorbed. 'Usually' stays unread. [AI reading]

says.en: Near-definitional, witnesses on Revising's process: a course opens a correction where no fitting uniform policy exists at x and one at x', “with one acceptability throughout, the gain coming from the reading, from executability or both”. Reading: “here the acceptability is fixed”.
Any process: every selection through an old lumping stays expressible through a new one exactly where new indistinguishability implies old, “and a merged old pair supplies a lost choice”.
Any type: where all hold a code merging two senses, “a form coined at one that the code does not give the other, heard by all, makes every formation tell them apart again”.
Any type: “Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step”.

account_adds.en: With every act counted acceptable, any configuration with an executable act is correctable already, so an opening counts only with acceptability held fixed. On Revising, replenishing alone can open it with the reading unchanged, so insight is neither necessary nor sufficient there.

source_adds.en: The historical thesis that insight usually leads; redefinition of the problem itself; the typology of misreading (moralize, privatize, suppress, ignore, take as fate).

name.en: A good idea is not an effective change: diffusion asked apart

source.locator: Claim 37; The shape of a civilizational advance

sense.en: A good idea is not an effective change. Diffusion must be asked separately: against what resistance, and through what force, whether the state, the market, grassroots transmission or a crisis.

entries.quote: 一个好想法不等于一个有效改变

reading.en: The same separation in other terms: discrimination, support and enactment come apart in Revising; seeing, valuing and complying are told apart. Spread has minimal models: hearings with an adoption rule, an imposed code, members who stop reading their coupling. These are codes and acts in models, not a force of diffusion of a mechanism, and resistance is not measured. The laws do not rest on the source. [AI reading]

says.en: “in Revising, discrimination, support and enactment come apart (a correction the stock covers can be blocked by the link, one the link admits can lack stock)”.

“**Seeing is not valuing**: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter.” “**Coupling is not compliance**: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.”
Reading [AI reading, D45]: six conditions at once. “Observation is the first condition, necessary and not sufficient”; all six together still rank nothing.

Any type, runs of hearings: under hearings that take the form heard, the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use; “An imposed code makes all agree”, each formation losing the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges.

Any type, near-definitional: where every member from k on acts alike whatever its coupling at the acts reached, two worlds alike through the couplings before k give the same acts. It does not show when an actual member stops reading its coupling.

account_adds.en: In these models what spreads is not decided by merit: from a symmetric start which form wins is settled only by what breaks the symmetry. T7 forbids “a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading”, conjectured of actual metrics.

source_adds.en: The named forces of spread, resistance as an object of study, and the list of mechanism substrates (materials, institutions, law, movements, commerce).

name.en: Value without mechanism; tool without the problem

source.locator: Claims 21-22, 49; What is actually broken

sense.en: Two field failures. People put forward good value claims and design no mechanism that can land. People build tools without understanding the social problem they face. Movements offering only value and products optimizing only the product both fail.

entries.quote: 有些人提出了很好的价值主张，但没有设计出可以落地的机制

reading.en: The second has the form of the account's centre: a selection can succeed while what it cannot read is lost. The first has a test, in language models told what to do: an instruction alone did not keep a dependent they were not told of, and installing a direction needed couplings and failed for one model even so. It also meets the account's exposed side: its ethics is two premises, with no motivation or compliance shown. [AI reading]

says.en: “The account's centre [AI reading]: a selection can succeed while what it cannot read is lost, and the laws do not say whether that loss counts.”

“Every selection through a selector's couplings selects histories alike exactly when they are alike through them” (record); near-definitional, its force the supplied premise that a selection goes through the couplings.
T4, IN1 partly passed (with talk, one model of two): “no condition kept an untold dependent”; one model kept the seen dependent in 8 of 10 seasons with the scope, the other “failed even with talk”.
Not shown: “Any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance, or an unconditional or complete ranking of mixed comparisons”.
Achievable under stated conditions: “Yes, for named exits”, “each under its hypotheses, none shown to hold of an actual collective”.

account_adds.en: An exact reason a tool's success is silent on the setting: differences beyond a selector's couplings stay unselected, however hard it selects. An AI reading adds “Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.”

source_adds.en: The empirical diagnosis that movements and inventions fail this way, stated without data, and a mechanism that lands as the designer's task. The source's charge can be put to the account itself.

name.en: Problems of similar structure, linked and indexed

source.locator: Claims 23, 51, 56, 58-59; Why the index is the theory; Found by reading item 11

sense.en: People who think their problem new often face one of similar structure, met before at several levels. So organize by human problem and link exhibits by problem structure, with seven method relations as the vocabulary and typed, confidence-rated links, so a person can travel to structural ancestors. The README finds 'structure' never defined and the promise unfalsifiable as written.

entries.quote: 这些推荐不是因为它们属于同一学科，而是因为它们处理了相似的问题结构

reading.en: Both refuse discipline or shared words as the link. In the account sameness of structure is stated: a lumping the step goes alike across; a law whose hypotheses a case is shown to meet; a correspondence classed and checked. That supplies, for laws and texts, what the README finds missing for problems, and one law across domains stays conjectured. Nothing here says a present problem has an ancestor. [AI reading]

says.en: 相合: 「原文所说的结构，脊柱上有已检查之律与之结构相同。相合不是印证」; 定域 and 相分 defined beside it.
A law with content “can become a science's law for a domain only once the domain is shown to meet its hypotheses”, through a stated correspondence.

“Read as a correspondence, a unification adds no theorem and changes no verdict”; reward, training, selection, prices and votes as one selection through couplings: “the laws proved; one law across domains conjectured (T3)”.
理: “a lumping that models structure and change at once: one the step goes alike across”.

account_adds.en: Structural readings fail often: of 88 entries a reviser kept, a second checker corrected 84, and two reads are held unreliable (06 §7.1; the ratio not extended beyond them).

source_adds.en: An index of human problems, seven method relations, confidence on links, and the promise that a person's problem has a structural ancestor.

name.en: Reinvention as a retrieval failure of how history is stored

source.locator: What is actually broken; Claims 20, 24-25; Found by reading item 24

sense.en: Movements, products and inventions keep reinventing the wheel, not from laziness but because encyclopedias and museums store inventions as results, not as problem-solving. The corrective is an index change, intervening before action. The README adds that the mis-shaping may be incentivized.

entries.quote: it is a retrieval failure caused by an indexing decision

reading.en: No live text says how human experience is stored, retrieved or re-derived, or why. A form could be proposed and is not stated: an index is a lumping, and selection through it reaches only what it separates (selection-when-the-lumping-changes); that would be near-definitional and silent on why people reinvent. Nearby but other: a bounded recorder does not keep its whole history; the account's own verdict that its central results are known. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The diagnosis and its corrective entire. The repository's search-before-claiming duty is process, not live.

searched: reinvent, retriev, wheel, problem-indexed, by problem, 重复造, museum, 博物馆 across the overview, chapters, reviews and glossary; the only hit for wheel is Pinwheel scheduling
read: 02-MAP the merge laws and the reading 'Learners, archives and genomes are such recorders'

name.en: The eighth module: a method to borrow, adapt or avoid

source.locator: The eighth module is not history; Claims 39, 67, 69, 84

sense.en: The most important part of each exhibit is not history but a method a present actor can borrow, adapt or avoid, written as an action rule and not a slogan. What a user saves is the method, not the exhibit.

entries.quote: 用户可以收藏的不是展品，而是方法

reading.en: The closest form is only of format: the account's exits are conditional moves, each with its edge, from models and not from history, holding only where hypotheses are met; the source's method travels by resemblance from a success. On method transfer itself, one periphery construction installs a method by a tested round and fails with a changed context. No live text addresses an actor's use of a historical case. [AI reading]

says.en: A table of exits, each law with model, hypotheses and edge. “Every capture law here is a two-kind count model, its locks stated without noise.” What it does not show: “That any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective, institution or trained system.”

Periphery, everything from task to compliance supplied: a practice round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry installs the context's method in the worker; “missing response or revision, early departure, changed context and untested admission fail.”

account_adds.en: Each exit states where it stops working, including when its window closes.

source_adds.en: Methods extracted from historical cases, written for an actor, and the toolbox that carries them.

name.en: The condom rule: tools for what regulation cannot enter

source.locator: Claims 45-47; The eighth module is not history

sense.en: If a problem occurs in highly private, shameful, dispersed, hard-to-regulate settings, the solution must be low-cost, private, autonomously usable, and must not require people first to change into their ideal selves. It comes from reading the condom as converting a bundle of problems into a portable tool.

entries.quote: 如果一个问题发生在高度私人、羞耻、分散、难以监管的场景里

reading.en: Proposed here; the account does not state it. A hard-to-regulate setting can be read as lying beyond what couples into a regulating selector, which cannot select on it. A tool used in the setting moves selection to one that does couple in. Only that premise has a form: 'must', cost, privacy and autonomy have no counterpart, and whether a case meets the premise is empirical. [AI reading]

says.en: “With the rest fixed, selection is blind beyond the coupling closure” (record). Proved, near-definitional, its force the supplied premise that a selection goes through the couplings; who selects and what couples in are not derived.

“A group's closure is the union of its members' closures”; “Differences beyond the union stay unselected”. Not shown: which formations pool, or that a pool's selection responds to what it separates (record).

source_adds.en: The design rule itself, drawn from one case, as the README's own critique of over-abstraction says; the bundle reading of the condom; shame and dispersal as conditions.

name.en: Good tools do not ask people to become nobler first

source.locator: Claim 48; The eighth module is not history; Found by reading item 15

sense.en: Good civilizational tools usually do not demand that people first become nobler; they offer a better option within real human nature, situations and limits. Design for the humans that exist. The README warns that, unamended, this licenses products that meet people where they are and keep them there.

entries.quote: 好的文明工具，往往不是要求人先变得更高尚

reading.en: The account takes up the words 'good' and 'better', not the design stance. Those comparisons go ungrounded in the source; here a ranking needs C or a premise in its place, the continuation condition fixing whose losses count, neither asserted, and 'better' says what it reads. The account's institution model presupposes no compliance, but only by merging it into a count. The README's worry has a form if a tool's success is selection through what it couples into. [AI reading]

says.en: “C gives order; a ranking needs it or a premise in its place”. The continuation condition fixes scope; “neither asserted, warrant open”.
“Holder merges recognition, compliance and implementation into one count, so the laws say nothing of them.”

With a selection through the couplings as a supplied condition, “a flow raising what couples in from beyond is selected” (record). The laws do not derive whether an actual selection goes through the couplings.

account_adds.en: What a tool's success reads and what it cannot, as a question of couplings and not of its designer's aim.

source_adds.en: An anti-perfectionist stance about human nature and how to design for it. A search for human nature, 人性, virtue, nobler and ideal self found no live statement of it.

name.en: Personal failure that a public institution must carry

source.locator: Claim 35; Claim 71 (accessible design); The shape of a civilizational advance; Relations (relational-self-and-datong)

sense.en: One insight archetype: some problems treated as personal failure actually require a public institution to carry them (public health, libraries, accessible design). The 'individual defect' is rewritten as a problem of design or of the public system.

entries.quote: 某些被认为是个人失败的问题，其实需要公共制度来承接

reading.en: Part has a form: admission is read on conditions and requirements together, not on the formation alone, and a loss can be made only jointly, the but-for holding for no single part. So a loss need not be any one part's. 'Must carry' comes only conditionally, under C and J1-J4 with the condition for scope, and fixes no carrier. Responsibility is not shown to differentiate. [AI reading]

says.en: “What can form is what a course *admits*: formations (what takes and gives) whose conditions meet their requirements.” At the root, responsibility is “not shown to differentiate”.
Any process, withholding a supplied map: “a law states exactly when parts make a difference only together” (record), which “Yields no responsibility, duty or ranking.”
World, balance: “Formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more”. Restates the commons.
Conditional (the condition for scope, C for order, J1-J4): “it can warrant building shared capacity without fixing one carrier”; “It does not establish compliance or derive institutional authority”.

account_adds.en: A statement of which part made a difference, by a supplied withholding map, with no blame in it; and overbuilding that depletes the living basis as the conditional result's counterexample.

source_adds.en: Shame and moralization as what hides the structure; the institutional cases; a public institution as the carrier. The account's institution model has no such role.

name.en: The multicellular organism as a system that eliminated the pattern

source.locator: Claim 2; The older question underneath; In Ren's own words 1

sense.en: The first named exception to the runaway dynamic: the multicellular organism, treated as a system, 'successfully eliminated this pattern', and one should ask why and how. Asked in a chat turn, as a question with a premise.

entries.quote: multicellular organism, if treated as a system, successfully eliminated this pattern, can you explain why and how

reading.en: The case has a checked form: a rise confined to a whole ends with it, whatever selection within raised, and where next founders carry their founder's value, selection among wholes decides. So 'eliminated' narrows: the rise within is not removed, it is bounded by named clauses. Known results restated; that a tumour or germ line meets the clauses is empirical. [AI reading]

says.en: “A lineage confined to a whole's conditions in excess has no member once they end, whatever selection within raised” (record); a sequestered founding is a hypothesis. Not shown: “How parts first come to live as one” (record); removal of parts by the whole's rule is not stated.

account_adds.en: In a witness a lineage depending on a condition outside the body still has a member a cohort after the end; without sequestering, a variant selected within lowers the founding value. Neither is called better: a ranking needs C, with the continuation condition for scope, both unasserted.

source_adds.en: That the organism eliminated the pattern, and the explanation why, including the policing the account leaves unstated.

name.en: The research question: which systems resisted, and what the museum dropped of it

source.locator: Claims 2-3; The older question underneath; The gap between the two collections; What was lost items 1-2

sense.en: The method: generalize the failure dynamic, enumerate the exceptions, extract what they share; hunter-gatherer bands and others are later candidates. The README's AI reading: the museum kept this format and dropped its subject. Conversion and regulation are different shapes, no module asks what kept a mechanism from capture or what happened when it was captured, and the violence hall vanished.

entries.quote: these are conversion moves, not regulation moves

reading.en: The account takes up the regulation side the museum dropped: loops that lock, named exits, routes of correction taken over. But it gets them from models, not a collection of exceptions, says 'No guarantee', and shows none of an actual collective. 'Worked' and 'resisted' read nothing until a comparison is named. Institutions enter only as AI readings. Bounded conflict is the nearest to the violence hall; the word does not appear. [AI reading]

says.en: “**No guarantee.**” “**exits** from the loops that lock a collective, each holding under stated hypotheses”; achievable “Yes, for named exits”, “none shown to hold of an actual collective”.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: “Term limits, audits, courts and antitrust carry what an actor's acts do back into what selects the rule: pooling, not opposed interests.” Bounded conflict: a loop closes a difference “only through a link giving back less than it received (compensation, arbitration, absorption)”.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: “A second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves”. “That readers are minds is a reading; none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.”
“**Institutions and people.**” “no field test of reform events is frozen (one designed could not be frozen as designed”; “no test has human participants.”

account_adds.en: Windows: a reading of what lies beyond the share counts only while its readers are not yet the fewer [AI reading, D67]. What comes back to shapers alone decides, at a step, whether control over the rule is selected (counts models).

source_adds.en: A comparative collection of exceptions and what they share; hunter-gatherer bands, which a search does not find; conversion moves; a state for what worked and was destroyed; how humans reduced violence.

name.en: Value systems as regulators; equality as stability

source.locator: Claim 4; The older question underneath; In Ren's own words 3

sense.en: Historical societies held value systems that kept selfishness from compounding beyond regulatory control, which is why they lasted or held equilibrium. This, and not morality, is the root reason equality is needed.

entries.quote: This is the root cause we need equality

reading.en: Nearest forms: at a step, capacity to shape the rule falls where nothing comes back to shapers alone and it costs them, in count models; a rule held by members can keep a level inside a band, and can be the wrong rule. Why societies lasted is not addressed. Equality is not derived as a stability requirement: equal shares meet every need only where they meet the greatest. Any ranking of open rule-making needs C. [AI reading]

says.en: Counts: “At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where `c ≤ s`”; “With nothing coming back and a cost, the shapers' share falls strictly at every step”. Reading: “nothing here ranks open rule-making above capture: that needs C.”

Reading [AI reading, new]: “neither the rule's being present nor its being held decides: a rule can be kept and be the wrong rule”. “**Not modelled:** why a teacher turns anyone away, conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision, mixed tenures, schism, records and purposes.”
Any type, whole-number amounts: “Equal shares meet every need exactly where they meet the greatest, giving more than the total need where needs differ”.

“no law says a drain is a harm, restraint better, cooperation good or a shared code worth keeping.” That is asked under 07's two premises, “the continuation condition for scope and C for order”, neither asserted.

account_adds.en: Positions sum to zero, so a rise needs a fall (05 §3): conflict stays real and no rule removes it. A regulator lags wherever the world changes faster than it reads [AI reading].

source_adds.en: The historical explanation of longevity, value systems rather than entry rules or count models as the regulator, and equality as a stability reason.

name.en: Traditions as social technology, with structural advantage

source.locator: Claims 6, 8; Terms: social technology; In Ren's own words 6, 8-9

sense.en: Confucianism is an excellent cognitive framework, a social technology, judged from cognitive and neural science, and classical Chinese narratives have clear structural, not merely moral, advantages against being consumed by Moloch. Are there others of that calibre? The README says the museum's own collection dropped this category.

entries.quote: 还有其他同样优秀的social technology吗

reading.en: 06 reads such texts passage by passage against the spine, 50 of them Confucian, as agreement, scope or divergence, and credits no tradition with an advantage or a calibre. 'Excellent' and 'advantage' would have to say what compares, among what. Its gaps table reads 二柄 and 壹 as naming capture through the rule, not resistance to it. Structural agreement is no testimony to a tradition's efficacy. [AI reading]

says.en: “**The classical texts** name the grammar's terms, not its operations; the readings are AI's”.
Assessment [AI reading, D54]: 248 passages each classed; 儒家 50, of them 17 相合, 21 定域, 12 相分. Limit: selection favours passages with structure to read, so 礼的细节 and others 「最可能进一步相分，表中段数低估了它们」.
A gap named by passages and since proved: 经由规则的捕获, from 韩非“二柄”, 管子“据有余而制不足”, 商君书“壹”.

account_adds.en: Four non-relational layers recur in the texts, each answered inside the same tradition (06 §六); a Confucian critic's 以理杀人 is read as a model applied where others' differences do not couple in.

source_adds.en: Tradition as engineered technology; a comparative judgement of calibre; a cognitive-science warrant; resistance to Moloch, a word the live account does not use.

name.en: A tradition's high point and degenerate mode coexist

source.locator: Claim 7; In Ren's own words 5; Genealogy 2026-03

sense.en: A high point and a degenerate mode of one tradition coexist: Confucian logic also became the value and pursuit of those who held or sought power, especially in prosperous periods. The README reads this as the anti-sanctification rule applied to a social technology.

entries.quote: 中国你说的高光时刻和退化模式是同时存在的

reading.en: A counter-rule read from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did; the account reads the imperial examination so, designed to dilute hereditary capture, later a proxy trap. Winners forming the minds that read the rule is read as the same law on the reading. A tradition turning into what power's carriers value has that form if its reading comes from their share. The account says this of the examination only, as a reading. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: “a counter-rule whose rule came to be read from the share it selected”, the imperial examination the earlier work's example. A reading favouring only above a threshold, from a start against it, may never lock.

Any type: with selection not lowering share and the rule read monotonically from it, the course locks. “That actual rules read the share is the premise.” “The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours”.
Reading [AI reading]: “winners forming the minds that read it is `ReadsShare` on the reading”. “Patterns of capture pass as patterns of care do.” “That readers are minds is a reading”.

account_adds.en: What leaves the lock: a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection, or a reversal held past a threshold.

source_adds.en: The historical claim about Confucian logic and prosperity; coexistence of the high and degenerate, where the law gives a lock and not a coexistence.

name.en: Halakha read as decentralized coordination engineering

source.locator: Claim 9; In Ren's own words 10 (brought forward and endorsed, the README notes)

sense.en: Talmud/Halakha is, from an engineering perspective, possibly the most successful decentralized coordination system in history: dissent preserved, micro-behaviour normed, no territory and no army. A passage brought forward and endorsed in a chat, not authored there; a claim about what it achieved, not a study.

entries.quote: 从工程角度看这可能是人类历史上最成功的去中心化协调系统

reading.en: Two of its features have forms, neither about this tradition, of which the account says nothing and I know little. Kept dissent: a pool adds exactly the differences its members hold, and an imposed code loses them. No army: a rule rebuilt through members, with sanctions and schism unmodelled; consent and penalty look alike until removal is in the net. 'Most successful' is a comparison that names nothing it reads. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D54] of 和而不同: 「成员有清单、各自之耦合可判定时，池所增加的恰是差别，相同者合用什么也不增加」.

Any type: “An imposed code makes all agree; each formation loses exactly the distinctions its code drew that the imposed code merges”; a merged distinction returns only from a form held outside, or by coining.

Root, a family of models: a rule of entry passed through members, “with no compliance and no records”. “**Not modelled:** why a teacher turns anyone away, conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision, mixed tenures, schism, records and purposes.”
Reading [AI reading, D69]: “An institution kept by its members' consent and one held by penalties” are one witness read socially, “told apart once their removal is in the net”. “not a new law”.

account_adds.en: A test of what no army would mean: keep and penalty are told apart only when removal enters the net. Being joined through couplings does not suffice for agreement.

source_adds.en: The reading of Talmud/Halakha itself; norming of micro-behaviour; the comparative superlative. The words Talmud, Halakha and 塔木德 do not appear in the live account.

name.en: The 奏折 as a zero-trust protocol, and how a polity gets true reports

source.locator: Claims 12-13; The older question underneath; In Ren's own words 13-14, 16 (endorsed)

sense.en: The 奏折 is a formatted protocol and the object of study is the whole bureaucratic system: in a low-bandwidth, high-latency, zero-trust setting, minimal metadata plus structured language gave accurate, private, auditable two-way communication. The question behind it: how does a large polity get accurate information upward under adversarial incentives?

entries.quote: 在一个低带宽、高延迟、零信任的环境里

reading.en: Neither object nor mechanism appears. Neighbours ask other things: an AI reading calls an institution's rule of reading reports a link, on whether a correction can be enacted; audits are read as pooling; corruption of audit as a second-order loop; one reader's schedule is a law about reading conditions within a margin. None states accuracy, privacy or auditability of report under adverse incentives. 05 §12 models no records. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The reading of a historical institution as protocol engineering, and the governance question behind it.

searched: 奏折, 奏摺, memorial, zero-trust, untrusted, byzantine, upward, audit, members report, institution, and record-index for report, signal, honest, audit, channel, protocol, bandwidth, deliver, verif
read: 03-KNOWING the reading after r-a-revision-that-opens-a-correction ('the link is its rule of reading what its members report')

name.en: Comparison across civilizations and scales; the narrow axis corrected

source.locator: Claims 14-15; In Ren's own words 7, 15

sense.en: Governance protocols are compared across civilizations and down the scale ladder to groups. The Chinese and American axis is itself too narrow: other cultures must be read on the self-others and individualism-collectivism spectrum. The README says the museum specification dropped that correction.

entries.quote: just realized i might be to bounded by chinese and american perspective

reading.en: The live account holds no such comparison: its classical chapter reads Chinese texts, its reviews Buddhist thought, philosophy, logic, alignment and the sciences. 'No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method' is another point. Its 'cell, organ, body, ecosystem' is one biological case, not a ladder of polities. This crosswalk's domain list aims at the breadth, but stands in process, not live. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The comparative programme across civilizations and scales, and the self-correction on bias.

searched: individualis, collectivis, cross-cultural, non-Western, Indigenous, hunter, forager, small-scale, Dunbar across the overview, chapters, reviews and glossary (no hits); culture, cultural (hits are flour beetle cultures and D58's reading)
read: 08-METHOD 'No cultural origin validates or disqualifies a method'

name.en: Cultures read at collective cognitive dynamics, living cases included

source.locator: Claims 10-11; In Ren's own words 11-12

sense.en: Cultures must be read at the level of collective cognitive dynamics, not customs; the surface is the wrong resolution. The search includes living cases: a culture still of high harmony, cooperation and openness, one not organized by collective trauma.

entries.quote: Too surface, I want to know what cognitive dynamics, thought dynamics are at play collectively

reading.en: The account's collective reading is thinner and exact: codes formed by hearing, and readers counted by kind inside a selection. That those readers are minds, institutions or a culture is itself marked a reading, and its collectives are said to be pools, with consciousness open. So a culture's 'cognitive dynamics' is reachable only as who reads what, and no culture is read. Harmony and trauma have no counterpart. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D67]: the scorecard is read from the share because those it selects are, in growing number, its readers. “That readers are minds, institutions or a culture is a reading, kept from D58.”
Not shown: anything of a collective of consciousness: “the theory's collectives are pools of couplings and readers counted by kind, and consciousness is open”.
Any type: a code is a formation's map from senses to forms; a group agreeing at a sense keeps agreeing through every hearing closed for it. How long agreement takes is not stated.

account_adds.en: What a culture's reading is drawn from can lock what it reads: selection forming its own readers is the mechanism, not a mentality.

source_adds.en: Collective cognition as a level of study, the demand for a living culture as evidence, and harmony and collective trauma as what is read.

name.en: No unreviewed content in the voice of a factual archive

source.locator: Four refusals: Anti-authority-laundering, Anti-fake-governance; Claims 86-91

sense.en: Content without sources, review and licensing is prototype copy and must not be published in the voice of a formal archive. The guard is machine-enforced: public mode against unready content fails the build, and public release needs two reliable sources and approved fact and sensitivity review. A form must not imply a review pipeline that does not exist.

entries.quote: 没有来源和审核的内容只能作为原型文案，不应以正式事实档案口吻公开

reading.en: Same concern, another mechanism. The account labels what each statement is and says on its first page who checked what, so it implies no review that has not happened. It does not withhold text no person has reviewed; it says so. The museum's rule would hold such text back. Its own reading adds that no check inside the work can show it serves its purpose. [AI reading]

says.en: “the proofs are checked by machine, everything else only by AI review, and no person has yet reviewed it”.
“Every result statement in the chapters opens with one bold label, and a proved result names its base.” Theorem, conditional, assessment, reading and open are told apart.
Reading [AI reading, D66]: “no check run inside the work can show that the work serves what it is for”; “Only coupling those in widens what the work's selection reaches”.

account_adds.en: Standings beyond true or false, and the rule that a frozen rule fixes the scoring, not that it measures what the thesis names.

source_adds.en: A publication state machine, a source table, sensitivity review, image licensing, and refusal to publish below a floor: a build that fails rather than a label that warns.

name.en: AI may only propose structural links; a person writes them back

source.locator: Claim 115; The counterexamples: 'Structural similarity is a soft claim'

sense.en: Future AI recommendation is admitted only under constraint: AI may generate candidate relations only, each with type, dimension, confidence and reason; low-confidence ones are not shown publicly; a human review writes them back into the data.

entries.quote: future AI-generated relations may only be candidates

reading.en: The account meets the same risk differently. Its structural readings are made, revised and checked by AI and stand published with an AI label, no person having reviewed them; it answers unreliability with more AI reads and stated counts, not a person's gate. Under the museum's rule 06's correspondences would stay candidates. The source's rule is a design, and the account does not say it is wrong: review by people is what it says is missing. [AI reading]

says.en: “The corpus was classified sentence by sentence in two frozen rounds by AI, and no person has yet reviewed the classification; which sentence reads as which theorem is AI reconstruction”.
「修订者原样保留的 88 条，第二位检查者读后 84 条要改正」; 「只经两读的条目不可靠；三读之后仍可能有错」. Classes, readings and names are AI's [AI reading, D62].
Reading [AI reading, D66]: “Only coupling those in widens what the work's selection reaches: review by people”, tests on trained systems, models of the test systems.

account_adds.en: A measured rate of error in structural reading, and that three reads are not enough to be sure.

source_adds.en: A human write-back gate and a confidence floor for what may be shown.

name.en: Against slogans and survivorship: conditions and failures on each method

source.locator: Claims 84, 98-100; What was lost item 7; Found by reading items 13-14

sense.en: Methods must not become slogans: each reserves steps, antiPatterns, notApplicableWhen and failureSignals, and a core method should rest on exhibits from several domains. The concept wants failed mechanisms marked; the README warns that a method library with no failure record is a survivorship machine, and that ten seeds are pretty examples.

entries.quote: 它们是避免方法库口号化的长期接口

reading.en: The account's statements carry the same slots, and fills them: hypotheses, what is not shown, what would show it wrong, failed tests reported, premises shown holding in one model and failing in another. A finite record does not certify renewal, on the renewable process, which is the survivorship point in one model. The museum's fields are all empty, by its README. Its bias is of a collection; the laws' are of a record. [AI reading]

says.en: A column on what would show each wrong; T1 “passed in two simulations and on held-out yeast regimes the analyst had seen, failed in four settings”.
What survives includes “the premise ledger, with witnesses both ways and its calibrations”, none of it a discovery.

The renewable process: for every horizon, two runs agree before it and then one renews and one consumes, so a reading fixed by h steps that includes every renewing run includes a consuming one. The home says the force lies in the words every renewing run, “which overdraws before `h`”.
Reading's table: material reproduction, “persistence and growth do not certify renewal”.

account_adds.en: A failure reported where a thesis's frozen test failed, and the wording changed to say so: failure entered into the text, not left in a separate wing.

source_adds.en: A place for failed historical mechanisms and 'do not reuse', a wing for the unsolved, a rule of support across domains, and the collection-level selection bias.

name.en: Open with a threshold: nomination, curators, two sources

source.locator: Claims 79-81, 89; Found by reading item 16

sense.en: The museum is never finished and open to nomination, but openness is not no threshold: candidates answer the dossier's questions, curators review, discussion and revision go on; public release needs two reliable sources. It would be neither rigid authority nor arbitrary platform. The README finds who curates, appeal and withdrawal undefined.

entries.quote: 但开放不等于无门槛

reading.en: Counting two sources counts names. In the account reviewers count by independent causes: two moved under one cause fail while every name is kept, and a copied witness adds nothing. Readers drawn from the selected can lock a rule, and a pool recruiting only through itself reads a loss only if a reader comes from outside. These laws locate the README's gap on curators; they do not speak of museums. [AI reading]

says.en: Pure core, fault formulas and bounds supplied, faithful reviewers: “Reviewers count by independent causes, not names.” Not shown: that the formulas are the actual causes of failure (record).
Any type, finite roster: a witness copying one already on it changes no certificate. “That a witness merely agreeing with another, without copying it, adds nothing is not shown”.
Any type: read the rule as the pool of its readers' readings; the rule read is then a monotone function of the share exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'.
“a pool recruiting only through itself couples into a loss only as its course without the loss would”, “unless a reader is admitted from outside” (witness).

account_adds.en: Independence of causes as the count, where the source counts sources by type.

source_adds.en: The governance loop of open nomination, public discussion, curatorial review and revision, and the honest refusal to simulate it in v0.1.

name.en: 活博物馆 as 生生 applied to knowledge

source.locator: Relations (becoming); Terms: living museum

sense.en: The folder relates itself to the account this way: the living museum is 生生 applied to knowledge, a system that goes on generating and is never finished, rather than a finished archive.

entries.quote: 活博物馆 is 生生 applied to knowledge

reading.en: The account's 生生 is life in the whole and its continuing generation, and 'nor any new organization': a growing knowledge system is not a case of it by name. What the source means is nearer another law: under a fixed rule the possible does not keep widening, so openness is in how rules keep changing, which is enough for neither. The sentence that an account of an unfolding is not finished by sealing it uses a law by analogy, and says so. [AI reading]

says.en: 生生: “life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1].” “Neither the grammar's `«生生»` (renewal without end), nor 02's generation (生成) as such, which allows loss, nor any new organization.” T8 argues it under the continuation condition for scope and C for order.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: “Keeping it widening needs the rule held to change without end, and its changing without end is not enough.” “Nothing here says which changes keep it widening, or that any actual collective can make them.”
“The work is not a flow, and the law is used here only by analogy: an account of an unfolding that keeps generating is not finished by sealing it.”

account_adds.en: Completion read three ways, one an exact statement of what cannot be shown.

source_adds.en: A knowledge institution's revisability as a way of being alive; a museum built against the museum as dead holding.
